name: Francis Smith
bioAdditions: Weygant (1897) says Capt. Francis and Capt. Austin Smith were residents of Woodbury Clove 'some twenty years or more' before the Revolution. Austin was captain of the Woodbury Clove company in 1771, and Francis succeeded him at the reorganization a year later, 'at the time a widower with two grown daughters'. Francis's eldest daughter Elizabeth married John Weygant, and a granddaughter of James & Jerusha Smith, Jerusha Smith, married Tobias Weygant (S1).

sources.citation: C. H. Weygant, The Family Record (1897; devoted to the Sackett, Weygant and Mapes families and intersecting lines), pp. 144-145, 'Smiths of Smithtown', Generations III-V
